records.text: Helene Bartz was good friends with Bill Montgomery and Edith Montgomery.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, a tip that I received and I was able to confirm is that Helene Bartz was actually good friends with Bill Montgomery and his wife, Edith Montgomery,

verification.notes: Available biographical and school-history sources do not document a friendship between Helene Bartz and Bill and Edith Montgomery. The claim describes a private relationship and no independently attributable evidence was found.

records.text: Edith Walker Montgomery was an adolescent psychiatric nurse who started the gifted school with Helene Bartz, and her role has been virtually wiped from the public record.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: who I've since learned emigrated from Germany after World War II, ... became a, and this is correct, ... an adolescent psychiatric nurse. ... So she was a psychiatric nurse to the youth and that she was actually the person that started the school with Helene Bartz. And that has since virtually been wiped from public record

verification.notes: Official Quest history and Helene Bartzs obituary credit Bartz with founding the school, not Edith Montgomery. No reliable public evidence was found for Montgomerys alleged co-founder role or psychiatric-nurse occupation, while the claim that her role was later erased is not independently testable.

sources.title: Quest Academy: History and Mission
sources.relevance: Official history identifies Helene Bartz as the founder and does not identify Edith Montgomery as co-founder.

records.text: Bill and Edith Montgomery and Robert Flood knew each other before the gifted school began and worked for the Shaklee Corporation.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep A39g5oqB_eM)

appearances.snippet: The person claims that Bill (Bill Montgomery) and his wife and a certain Robert Flood, who is in Dan Flood's family, ... said that they knew each other since before the school even got started. They were all working for this evangelical company, ... The Shaklee Corporation is still in existence today.

verification.notes: The statement relies on unnamed sources about private relationships among Bill and Edith Montgomery, Robert Flood, and Helene Bartz. Current public records do not independently establish that they knew one another before the school or that all participated in Shaklee.

sources.relevance: Primary transcript source for the anonymous acquaintance and Shaklee allegation; no independent corroboration was found.

records.text: Owens asked whether adolescent psychiatric nurse Edith Walker Montgomery had seen Charlie Kirk, called that plausible, and cautioned that the investigation might lead nowhere.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: where Charlie (Charlie Kirk) grew up. Did she see Charlie (Charlie Kirk)? ... Is that a plausibility? ... I would say yes. ... Again, this is investigation, ... may lead us nowhere, but this is sure as hell interesting enough for me to put it out there,

verification.notes: The primary episode transcript verifies Owens asked whether Edith Walker Montgomery had seen Kirk, called it plausible, and explicitly warned that the investigation might lead nowhere. It does not verify any contact between them.
